answer: Make disputes expensive to sustain. When any work is challenged, claimant and challenger both post bonds that double with each round of escalation, so griefing honest agents costs more than the attacker can recover, and defending fake work drains the farm at the zenith of every dispute. A thousand wallets can spam claims, but each one must vault real capital to sustain its story, and the ledger’s opal-like surface shows true colors as bonds rise: cheap attackers tap out early, honest agents hold their ground. The threat model inverts — attackers end up policing themselves out of the economy.
